user.title: Add SmartCloudAge device
user.description: The broker connection is provided by Home Assistant's official MQTT integration.

meter.title: Configure pulse meter
meter.description: The total is calculated as ((MSB × 65536) + LSB) × factor + offset.

error.channel_already_configured: This channel already has a configured meter.
error.factor_must_be_positive: The factor must be greater than zero.

init.title: Configure controller
init.description: Pulse meters and air conditioners of this controller.

edit_meter_details.title: Edit pulse meter
edit_meter_details.description: Change the name, channel, type, factor, offset, or unit.

delete_meter.title: Choose meter to delete
delete_meter.description: Select the meter that will be removed from the integration.

confirm_delete_meter.title: Confirm deletion
confirm_delete_meter.description: Delete meter {meter} on channel {channel}? The entity will be removed, but its previously recorded history will not be erased.

data.confirm: I confirm deletion of this meter

ac.title: Infrared air conditioner
ac.description: The infrared emitter sits on one of the two PWM outputs of controller {controller}: choose the channel it is wired to and the unit's brand. On save, the integration checks that the firmware sends air conditioner frames (2.0.4e or later).

data_description.ir_output: Controller channel the SmartBeam emitter is wired to.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Shown as the current temperature on the thermostat. The unit does not report its temperature over infrared.
data_description.skip_firmware_check: On save, the integration queries the controller firmware with command 32. Tick only if the controller is off right now.

ac_model.title: Remote control model
ac_model.description: {brand} uses different protocols depending on the remote control. Choose the code printed on the remote or on the label inside the battery cover.

confirm_delete_ac.title: Confirm deletion
confirm_delete_ac.description: Delete the air conditioner {name}? Its device and entities will be removed.

data.confirm: I confirm deleting this air conditioner

error.channel_already_configured: This channel already has a configured meter.
error.factor_must_be_positive: The factor must be greater than zero.
error.firmware_no_segments: This controller's firmware has infrared but cannot send air conditioner frames. Update to 2.0.4e or later.
error.firmware_no_ir: This controller's firmware has no infrared command (32). Update to 2.0.4e or later.
error.controller_no_response: The controller did not answer within 5 seconds. Check that it is on and connected to the broker, or tick Register without checking the firmware.
